a2_c01n08.titleTh: เสียงจากชมรม

items.audioText: Hi! Welcome to the club! We meet on weekends. See you on Saturday!
items.questionEn: When does the club meet?
items.questionTh: ชมรมเจอกันเมื่อไหร่?

items.audioText: Hi, it's Capy! I love drawing. I don't like swimming. It's too cold!
items.speaker: Capy
items.questionEn: What doesn't Capy like doing?
items.questionTh: Capy ไม่ชอบทำอะไร?

items.audioText: Hey! It's Max. I go jogging on weekends. How about you?
items.speaker: Max
items.questionEn: What does Max do on weekends?
items.questionTh: Max ทำอะไรทุกสุดสัปดาห์?

items.audioText: Hi, it's May. I enjoy baking. I don't like gaming.
items.speaker: May
items.questionEn: What does May enjoy doing?
items.questionTh: May สนุกกับการทำอะไร?

items.audioText: Hi! I'm Mali. I work at the café. I like surfing, but I don't like fishing.
items.speaker: Mali
items.questionEn: What doesn't Mali like doing?
items.questionTh: Mali ไม่ชอบทำอะไร?

a2_c07n07.titleTh: ข้อความเสียง

items.audioText: Hi, it's May. Would you like to see a movie this evening? Let's meet at seven.
items.speaker: May
items.questionEn: When does May want to see a movie?
items.questionTh: May ชวนไปดูหนังเมื่อไหร่ (พูดช่วงเวลา)?

items.audioText: Hi, it's Max. Shall we play badminton tomorrow? I'm free after school.
items.speaker: Max
items.questionEn: When does Max want to play badminton?
items.questionTh: Max ชวนเล่นแบดมินตันวันไหน?

items.audioText: Hello, it's Capy. How about drawing in the park next week? Let's meet at the lake.
items.speaker: Capy
items.questionEn: Where does Capy want to meet?
items.questionTh: Capy นัดเจอกันที่ไหน?

items.audioText: Hi, it's Teacher Bee. The club is going to practice on Friday at four. See you then!
items.speaker: Teacher Bee
items.questionEn: What time is the club going to practice?
items.questionTh: ชมรมจะซ้อมกี่โมง?

items.audioText: Hi, it's Mali. Would you like to cook at my house this evening? Come at six.
items.speaker: Mali
items.questionEn: What time should you go to Mali's house?
items.questionTh: Mali ให้ไปบ้านกี่โมง?

items.audioText: Hi, it's Teacher John. Sorry, I'm busy tomorrow. How about next week?
items.speaker: Teacher John
items.questionEn: When does Teacher John want to meet?
items.questionTh: Teacher John เสนอนัดใหม่เมื่อไหร่?

a2_c08n07.titleTh: ข้อความเสียงครูบี

items.audioText: Hi, team! It's Teacher Bee. Let's meet at the gate at six. See you then!
items.speaker: Teacher Bee
items.questionEn: Where does Teacher Bee want to meet?
items.questionTh: ครูบีนัดเจอกันที่ไหน?

items.audioText: Hi, it's Teacher Bee. Let's meet at the big wheel at seven thirty. Don't be late!
items.speaker: Teacher Bee
items.questionEn: What time does Teacher Bee want to meet?
items.questionTh: ครูบีนัดเจอกันกี่โมง?

items.audioText: It's Teacher Bee. I'm standing next to the ice cream stall. I'm wearing a blue shirt.
items.speaker: Teacher Bee
items.questionEn: What is Teacher Bee standing next to?
items.questionTh: ครูบียืนอยู่ข้างอะไร?
acceptedAnswers: Next to the ice cream stall.

items.audioText: Hi, it's Teacher Bee. I'm at the big wheel now. I'm wearing my glasses.
items.speaker: Teacher Bee
items.questionEn: Where is Teacher Bee now?
items.questionTh: ตอนนี้ครูบีอยู่ที่ไหน?

items.audioText: It's Teacher Bee. Max and May are at the ice cream stall. Let's all meet there at eight. Hurry up!
items.speaker: Teacher Bee
items.questionEn: What time is everyone going to meet?
items.questionTh: นัดเจอกันทุกคนกี่โมง?

items.audioText: Can you see me? It's Teacher Bee. I'm standing at the gate. I'm wearing a blue shirt and glasses.
items.speaker: Teacher Bee
items.questionEn: What color is Teacher Bee's shirt?
items.questionTh: ครูบีใส่เสื้อสีอะไร?

a2_c09n09.titleTh: ฟังออร์เดอร์ของ Mali

items.audioText: One medium iced latte for May!
items.speaker: Mali
items.questionEn: What size is May's latte?
items.questionTh: แก้วลาเต้ของ May ขนาดไหน?

items.audioText: A large hot tea for Capy, to take away.
items.speaker: Mali
items.questionEn: Is Capy's tea for here or to take away?
items.questionTh: Capy ทานที่ร้านหรือกลับบ้าน?

items.audioText: Three small iced lattes for John, for here.
items.speaker: Mali
items.questionEn: How many lattes did John order?
items.questionTh: John สั่งลาเต้กี่แก้ว?

items.audioText: A small latte for Teacher Nina. Hot, not iced!
items.speaker: Mali
items.questionEn: Is Teacher Nina's latte hot or iced?
items.questionTh: ลาเต้ของ Teacher Nina ร้อนหรือเย็น?

items.audioText: Sorry, Max. We don't have any hot milk today. We have hot tea and iced tea.
items.speaker: Mali
items.questionEn: Can Max get hot milk today?
items.questionTh: วันนี้ Max สั่งนมร้อนได้ไหม?
acceptedAnswers: No, they don't have any hot milk.

items.audioText: Hot tea, forty-five baht. Milk, fifty-five baht. Latte, sixty-five baht.
items.speaker: Mali
items.questionEn: You have 100 baht. Which two different drinks cost 100 baht?
items.questionTh: มีเงินพอดี 100 บาท อยากได้ 2 แก้วที่ไม่ซ้ำกัน และใช้เงินให้ครบ 100 บาท ซื้อคู่ไหน?
acceptedAnswers: A hot tea and some milk.
A hot tea and a milk.

items.audioText: Sorry, we don't have any curry today. The noodle soup is really spicy. The fried rice isn't spicy.
items.speaker: Mali
items.questionEn: Max can't eat spicy food. What should he order?
items.questionTh: Max กินเผ็ดไม่ได้ ควรสั่งจานไหน?
acceptedAnswers: He can have the fried rice.

items.audioText: I'm so sorry. We don't have any fried rice today. The curry is too spicy for Max. The noodle soup isn't spicy.
items.speaker: Mali
items.questionEn: Which dish isn't spicy?
items.questionTh: จานไหนไม่เผ็ด?

items.audioText: Sorry, no noodle soup today. We have curry and fried rice.
items.speaker: Mali
items.questionEn: Which dishes do they have today?
items.questionTh: วันนี้ร้านมีจานไหนบ้าง?
acceptedAnswers: The curry and the fried rice.
They have curry and fried rice.

items.audioText: Sorry, we don't have any noodle soup today. The curry is sweet, not spicy. The fried rice is really spicy.
items.speaker: Mali
items.questionEn: What should Max order?
items.questionTh: Max ควรสั่งจานไหน?

items.audioText: Hi, it's Mali again! Sorry, no curry today. The noodle soup is a bit spicy, but we can make the fried rice without chilli.
items.speaker: Mali
items.questionEn: Which dish can they make without chili?
items.questionTh: Mali บอกว่าร้านทำจานไหนแบบไม่ใส่พริกได้?

a2_c16n08.titleTh: แม่ค้าบนเรือ

items.audioText: Boat noodles are forty baht. Mango is thirty baht. Water is ten baht.
items.speaker: Mali
items.questionEn: How much are the boat noodles?
items.questionTh: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวเรือราคาเท่าไร?

items.audioText: Boat noodles are forty baht. Mango is thirty baht. Water is ten baht.
items.speaker: Mali
items.questionEn: One boat noodles and one water. How much is that?
items.questionTh: ซื้อก๋วยเตี๋ยวเรือ 1 ชาม กับน้ำ 1 ขวด รวมเป็นเงินเท่าไร?

items.audioText: Two boat noodles and one mango. That's one hundred and ten baht.
items.speaker: Mali
items.questionEn: What's the total?
items.questionTh: ยอดรวมเท่าไร?

items.audioText: One mango and one water. That's forty baht.
items.speaker: Mali
items.questionEn: You pay 100 baht. How much change do you get?
items.questionTh: คุณจ่าย 100 บาท ควรได้เงินทอนเท่าไร?

items.audioText: That's eighty baht. Here's your change, twenty baht.
items.speaker: Mali
items.questionEn: How much money did you give Mali?
items.questionTh: คุณให้เงิน Mali ไปกี่บาท?

items.audioText: Boat noodles, forty baht. Mango, thirty baht. Here's your change, twenty baht.
items.speaker: Mali
items.questionEn: You pay 100 baht. The change is wrong. What is the right change?
items.questionTh: คุณจ่าย 100 บาท Mali ทอนผิด เงินทอนที่ถูกคือเท่าไร?

a2_c17n08.titleTh: ประกาศสนามบิน

items.audioText: Flight 72 to Tokyo, please go to Gate 15 now. The gate closes at 10:20.
items.questionEn: Which gate do you need to go to?
items.questionTh: ต้องไปเกตไหน?
acceptedAnswers: We have to go to Gate 15.

items.audioText: Flight 72 to Tokyo, please go to Gate 15 now. The gate closes at 10:20.
items.questionEn: What time does the gate close?
items.questionTh: เกตปิดกี่โมง?

items.audioText: Good morning! Flight 18 to London leaves from Gate 5. Please be at the gate at 8:30.
items.questionEn: Which gate do you need to go to?
items.questionTh: ต้องไปเกตไหน?
acceptedAnswers: We have to go to Gate 5.

items.audioText: Flight 40 to Sydney: the gate is now Gate 9, not Gate 5. Please go to Gate 9.
items.questionEn: Which is the right gate?
items.questionTh: เกตที่ถูกต้องคือเกตไหน?
acceptedAnswers: We have to go to Gate 9.

items.audioText: Flight 40 to Sydney leaves at 11:45. Please be at Gate 9 at 11:15.
items.questionEn: What time do you need to be at the gate?
items.questionTh: ต้องไปถึงเกตกี่โมง?

items.audioText: ♪ I love my bus, I love my bus! ♪ Hi, it's Driver Uncle Somchai! Next stop, the museum! The museum! ♪ I love my bus! ♪
items.speaker: Driver Uncle Somchai
items.questionEn: What's the next stop?
items.questionTh: ป้ายถัดไปคือที่ไหน?
acceptedAnswers: The next stop is the museum.

items.audioText: Hello, hello! For the old town, get off at the market. The market is the third stop! ♪ I love my bus! ♪
items.speaker: Driver Uncle Somchai
items.questionEn: Where do you get off for the old town?
items.questionTh: จะไปเมืองเก่า ต้องลงป้ายไหน?

items.audioText: ♪ I love my bus, I love my bus! ♪ We're at the school now! Next stop, the museum, then the market!
items.speaker: Driver Uncle Somchai
items.questionEn: Where is the bus now?
items.questionTh: ตอนนี้รถจอดอยู่ที่ป้ายไหน?

items.audioText: Sorry, sorry! The market stop is closed today. Please get off at the school and walk five minutes. ♪ I love my bus! ♪
items.speaker: Driver Uncle Somchai
items.questionEn: The market stop is closed. Where should you get off?
items.questionTh: ป้ายตลาดปิด Driver Uncle Somchai บอกให้ลงป้ายไหนแทน?

items.audioText: Oh no, you missed the museum! Get off at the next stop. It's the market! ♪ I love my bus! ♪
items.speaker: Driver Uncle Somchai
items.questionEn: You missed the museum. Where do you get off?
items.questionTh: นั่งเลยป้ายพิพิธภัณฑ์แล้ว ต้องลงป้ายไหน?

a2_c21n10.titleTh: พยากรณ์อากาศ

items.audioText: Good morning, it's DJ Coco! On Friday it's going to be sunny. Saturday will be cloudy, and on Sunday it might be stormy... but that's OK!
items.speaker: DJ Coco
items.questionEn: Which day is good for the beach?
items.questionTh: วันไหนเหมาะไปทะเล?

items.audioText: Hello, hello, it's DJ Coco! Friday will be stormy... but that's OK! Saturday will be sunny and hot. Sunday will be cloudy.
items.speaker: DJ Coco
items.questionEn: Which day is good for the beach?
items.questionTh: วันไหนเหมาะไปทะเล?

items.audioText: Good morning, it's DJ Coco! Friday and Saturday will be cloudy and humid. But on Sunday it's going to be sunny! Have a nice day!
items.speaker: DJ Coco
items.questionEn: Which day is good for the beach?
items.questionTh: วันไหนเหมาะไปทะเล?

items.audioText: Good morning, it's DJ Coco! It might rain on Friday. Saturday is going to be stormy... but that's OK! Sunday will be sunny and warm!
items.speaker: DJ Coco
items.questionEn: Which day is stormy?
items.questionTh: วันไหนมีพายุ ไม่ควรไปทะเล?

items.audioText: Hello, it's DJ Coco! Friday will be cloudy. Saturday will be sunny in the morning, but stormy in the afternoon. But that's OK! Sunday will be sunny all day!
items.speaker: DJ Coco
items.questionEn: Which day is good for the beach all day?
items.questionTh: วันไหนเหมาะไปทะเลทั้งวัน?

a2_c22n10.titleTh: กินกี่เม็ด

items.audioText: Take two pills after meals, three times a day.
items.questionEn: How many pills do you take each time?
items.questionTh: ต้องกินครั้งละกี่เม็ด?

items.audioText: This is for your cough. Take one pill before meals, twice a day.
items.questionEn: Do you take it before or after meals?
items.questionTh: กินก่อนหรือหลังอาหาร?

items.audioText: This medicine is for May's fever. Take one pill after meals. Take it three times a day.
items.questionEn: How many times a day do you take it?
items.questionTh: กินวันละกี่ครั้ง?

items.audioText: Take two pills before breakfast. Only once a day, please.
items.questionEn: How many pills, and before or after breakfast?
items.questionTh: กินครั้งละกี่เม็ด ก่อนหรือหลังอาหาร?

items.audioText: We close in five minutes! Quick: take one pill after dinner, and drink a lot of water.
items.questionEn: How many pills, and before or after dinner?
items.questionTh: กินกี่เม็ด ก่อนหรือหลังอาหาร?

a2_c24n06.titleTh: ประกาศเที่ยวบิน

items.audioText: Flight BK 205 is delayed. It will now leave at 11:15 from Gate 12.
items.questionEn: Which gate will the flight leave from?
items.questionTh: เที่ยวบินจะออกจากเกตไหน?

items.audioText: Flight BK 205 is delayed. The new time is 9:40. Please go to Gate 15.
items.questionEn: What's the new time?
items.questionTh: เวลาใหม่คือกี่โมง?

items.audioText: Update for flight BK 205: the gate is now 15, not 12. The time is still 11:15.
items.questionEn: What's the new gate?
items.questionTh: เกตใหม่คือเกตไหน?

items.audioText: Sorry, flight BK 205 is delayed again. It's not 9:40 now. It will leave at 11:15.
items.questionEn: What time will the flight leave now?
items.questionTh: ตอนนี้เที่ยวบินจะออกกี่โมง?

items.audioText: Hello. Your flight is delayed. Please go to Gate 12 at 9:40. I'll give you a voucher there.
items.questionEn: Which gate, and what time?
items.questionTh: เจ้าหน้าที่บอกให้ไปเกตไหน กี่โมง?

a2_c30n09.titleTh: ฝากข้อความ

items.audioText: Hi, this is Mali from the restaurant. Sorry, Friday is full. Can we change it to Saturday at 6:30?
items.speaker: Mali
items.questionEn: What time does the restaurant want to change to?
items.questionTh: ร้านขอเลื่อนเป็นกี่โมง?

items.audioText: Hello, it's Mali. Please call me back. My number is 081 552 7340.
items.speaker: Mali
items.questionEn: What number do you need to call back?
items.questionTh: เบอร์ที่ต้องโทรกลับคือเบอร์อะไร?
acceptedAnswers: zero eight one, five five two, seven three four zero
zero eight one, double five two, seven three four zero

items.audioText: Hi Nina, it's Mali. We can't do 7:00 on Saturday. Is 6:00 OK?
items.speaker: Mali
items.questionEn: What time does Mali offer?
items.questionTh: ร้านเสนอเวลาใหม่กี่โมง?

items.audioText: Hello, this is Mali. The table for six is OK on Sunday, not Saturday. The time is 7:00.
items.speaker: Mali
items.questionEn: What time is the booking now?
items.questionTh: งานย้ายไปเป็นกี่โมง?

items.audioText: Hi, it's Mali again. Sorry, I can't talk now. Please call me on 02 455 9810.
items.speaker: Mali
items.questionEn: What's Mali's number?
items.questionTh: เบอร์ของ Mali คืออะไร?
acceptedAnswers: zero two, four five five, nine eight one zero
zero two, four double five, nine eight one zero

items.audioText: Hi, it's Mali from the restaurant. Please confirm the booking. Call me back before 5 p.m. today.
items.speaker: Mali
items.questionEn: When do you need to call back?
items.questionTh: ต้องโทรกลับก่อนกี่โมง?

items.audioText: Teacher Torto: OK, team. We're going to take the train to Chiang Mai. It leaves at 7:30 in the morning.
items.speaker: Teacher Torto
items.questionEn: How is the team going to travel?
items.questionTh: ทีมจะเดินทางด้วยอะไร?

items.audioText: Teacher Torto: The train leaves at 7:30, so please be at the station at 7:00.
items.speaker: Teacher Torto
items.questionEn: What time do you need to be at the station?
items.questionTh: ต้องไปถึงสถานีกี่โมง?

items.audioText: Teacher Torto: We're going to stay at a hotel next to the beach for three nights.
items.speaker: Teacher Torto
items.questionEn: How many nights are they going to stay at the hotel?
items.questionTh: จะพักโรงแรมกี่คืน?

items.audioText: Teacher Torto: We're going to come back on Friday. The train home leaves at 4:15 in the afternoon.
items.speaker: Teacher Torto
items.questionEn: What time does the train home leave?
items.questionTh: รถไฟขากลับออกกี่โมง?

items.audioText: Teacher Torto: We have to check in at the hotel at 2 p.m. Then we're going to visit a museum.
items.speaker: Teacher Torto
items.questionEn: What time do they have to check in?
items.questionTh: ต้องเช็กอินโรงแรมกี่โมง?

items.audioText: Teacher Torto: We're not going by plane. Flights are too expensive, so we'll take the train. It's cheaper.
items.speaker: Teacher Torto
items.questionEn: Why isn't the team going by plane?
items.questionTh: ทำไมทีมไม่ไปเครื่องบิน?
